All weights downloaded: ESMFold v1 (2.6GB), ESM2-3B (5.3GB), contact regression (6.7KB). Symlinked for torch.hub discovery.
DB5.5 benchmark validated: 186 pairs loaded (115 rigid, 55 medium, 16 difficult). All have native coordinates. 183 fit within 1024 token limit.
Conda environment "tttppi" created (clone of SE3nv + peft 0.13.2 + tmtools). Smoke tests passed: masking strategies, DockQ metrics, dataset loading.

Project initialized. Codebase created with 29 files. Setting up conda environment and downloading ESMFold weights (~8GB). Preparing DB5.5 benchmark dataset.

Created project structure: src/ (8 modules), scripts/ (7 runners), slurm/ (7 job scripts), configs/ (4 YAML configs). Core implementation: ESMFold+LoRA model wrapper, 3 masking strategies (uniform, cross-chain, interface-biased), confidence-guided checkpoint selection, DockQ/iLDDT/TM-score metrics.
